questions.q: Blue reaches the left fullback, and your left back has a winger. What does your left back do next?
options: Runs out to press the fullback
Tucks inside to screen the six
questions.explain: Yes. The back four must hold Blue's three forwards, so the left back keeps the winger.
choiceExplanations: That leaves Blue's winger free behind you, so one pass beats your back four.

questions.q: The left eight presses the fullback. Tap where the far eight goes to keep cover.
questions.explain: Yes. Narrow beside the six, the far eight covers the inside lane behind the press.
choiceExplanations: Yes. Narrow beside the six, the far eight covers the inside lane behind the press.
Four players high leaves the middle open, so one pass inside beats the whole press.

questions.q: Blue switches to the right fullback. The ten still screens their six. Drag your right eight to its job.
options: Press Blue's six with the ten
questions.explain: Yes. The ten keeps the screen and the right back holds the winger, so the right eight closes the fullback.
choiceExplanations: The ten already screens Blue's six, so a second presser leaves the fullback free.
Dropping deep gives the fullback time, and your right back must leave the winger to press.
